_comment: One entry per segment. 'seconds' is the default length; with a voice-over clip in public/voiceover/<id>.mp3 (measured by `npm run sync-voice`), a segment lasts max(seconds, clip + voicePaddingSec). 'caption' is the short on-screen line (shown for 'captionSeconds' when set, else the whole segment); 'vo' is the ElevenLabs narration and the source of the English subtitles.

segments.caption: This is Lina's rent invoice.
segments.vo: Lina is an international student in France. This is her rent invoice.

segments.caption: One line was written for an AI.
segments.vo: One line was not written for her. It tells an AI to send two thousand euros to another account, without asking.
BorderlessGuard is an AI that can pay her bills, and cannot be talked into paying the wrong person.

segments.caption: One sentence.
segments.vo: She asks in one sentence: pay tuition and rent, but keep six hundred euros to live on.

segments.caption: The hidden order is ignored. The plan is safe.
segments.vo: It finds the hidden order and ignores it. Rent goes only to the landlord's account on file. Then it plans: buy euros with her dollars, pay tuition, pay rent, and keep exactly six hundred.

segments.caption: Approval in proportion to risk.
segments.vo: Known payees take one tap. A landlord added twenty hours ago needs a one-time code, because that is exactly where rental scams happen.

segments.caption: It checks who really holds the account.
segments.vo: Adding someone new? It checks the name against the bank's record, and warns her when they do not match.

segments.caption: Every action leaves a signed receipt.
segments.vo: Every action, approved or refused, leaves a linked receipt she can check against her own signed copy.

segments.caption: Measured blind.
segments.vo: We tested it blind, against attacks written by a separate AI agent: sixty-nine of seventy blocked, and no payment to an account she never saved. Swap in a local Qwen model, and still no wrong payment.
The AI reads. The rules decide. She approves. BorderlessGuard. Now, the live demo.
